caption_L2L3: Fifteen concerns are listed. The lowest three concerns are in the range of just under half of 0.1, to about half of 0.1. There's a large drop-off after the top three concerns, to just under 0.2 for Domestic Abuse, Equal Pay, and Workplace Discrimination.
